body.x: Holi (www.holimotion.com), which specializes in smart lighting devices, unveiled "SleepCompanion" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The lighting solution SleepCompanion is clinically proven to help users sleep. It is equipped with an exclusive light-bulb which synchronizes with the body's biological rhythm by generating the right amount of light depending on the situation. A smartphone app which connects to this device analyzes the sleep patterns and provides personalized advices to improve sleep.
